sourceEvidence.title: Associate Director of Engineering, Command and Control (C2) Architect (Onsite)
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 12 years prior relevant experience **or** an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 10 years of experience.
* Demonstrated experience with command-and-control systems, architectures, or mission workflows.
* Proven ability to perform system-level analysis and trades for complex mission systems.
* Experience developing or analyzing architectures using industry frameworks (e.g., DoDAF, UML, SysML).
* Familiarity with electronic warfare concepts, cyber operations, or effector systems.
* 7+ years of relevant engineering or architecture experience.
* Active and transferable Top Secret U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date.
* U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S.
